subject: POC trial planning: success criteria & RACI - Sunrise Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Carter <jamie.carter@sunrisehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: POC trial planning: success criteria & next steps (Sunrise Health)

Hi Jamie —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment before we draft the POC plan:

Key goals you mentioned:
- Validate Redwood inference latency and throughput for your patient-portal use case (500 concurrent sessions, 512 token average).
- Ensure no PHI is persisted outside your tenant; audit logs and KMS integration required.
- Confirm result quality on a representative prompt set (NLP accuracy & hallucination rate).

Proposed POC success criteria (attached spreadsheet):
1) Latency: 95th percentile generation latency <= 300ms at expected concurrency (500 sessions).
2) Throughput: sustain 200 requests/sec with tail latency SLA.
3) Quality: >= 92% on the evaluation prompt set (see tab "Eval Prompts").
4) Security: end-to-end data isolation — data only stored in your Azure tenant, keys managed via your KMS.
5) Observability: console access to per-route token costs, traces, and audit logs for the trial period.

High-level evaluation plan and timeline:
- Week 0: Sign SOW / terms and confirm infra approach (shared vs. single-tenant).
- Week 1: Infra provisioning + model onboarding; sample dataset ingestion (anonymized).
- Week 2: Run load & quality tests; collect metrics.
- Week 3: Final report + handoff.

RACI (draft):
- Redwood infra provisioning & trial ops: Aditya Rao (Solutions Engineer) — Responsible
- App integration / sample prompt mapping: Sunrise engineering (Alex Nguyen) — Accountable
- Security & compliance sign-off: Sunrise Security — Consulted
- Procurement / contract: Sunrise Procurement — Informed/Accountable for signatures

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll attach a draft RACI + success criteria spreadsheet for your review.
2) Please share the security contact and procurement contact so we can include them on the thread.
3) Confirm whether you require trial instances on your Azure subscription or if you prefer Redwood-hosted isolated tenant.

Attachments: Sunrise_POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx, Sunrise_RACI_Draft.pdf

Thanks — talk soon,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

From: Jamie Carter <jamie.carter@sunrisehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@sunrisehealth.com>, Security Team <security@sunrisehealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-13T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial planning: success criteria & next steps (Sunrise Health)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap — this looks good and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications and asks from our side: 

1) Security: Our security lead (Alex Nguyen) is cc'ed — Alex will need to validate the SOC2 evidence and run a short privacy review. We prefer data to remain in our Azure tenant; KMS integration is required.

2) Procurement: I've looped in procurement. They typically need a short trial addendum and an estimate for costs during the pilot.

3) Timeline: We are targeting a decision by the end of July. Can Redwood commit to the Week 1–3 timeline you outlined if we sign SOW by next week?

4) RACI: Please add procurement as "Accountable" for contract sign-off and include Security as "Consulted". Also, can you assign an internal Redwood owner for infra provisioning?

Attaching our initial POCTerms doc for your legal review: Sunrise_POCTerms.pdf

Thanks,

Jamie Carter
Head of Product | Sunrise Health
jamie.carter@sunrisehealth.com | (206) 555-0114

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Carter <jamie.carter@sunrisehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@sunrisehealth.com>, Security Team <security@sunrisehealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial planning: success criteria & next steps (Sunrise Health)

Great — thanks Jamie. Yes, Redwood can commit to the Week 1–3 plan conditional on SOW execution next week.

Per your ask, assigning internal ownership:
- Redwood infra provisioning & trial ops (Responsible): Aditya Rao (cc'd) — will set up an isolated tenant or connect to your Azure subscription per your preference.
- Redwood account lead (Overall owner / point of contact): Marissa Cole — will coordinate success criteria and run evaluations.
- Customer integration & app ownership (Accountable): Alex Nguyen (Sunrise)
- Security & compliance (Consulted): Sunrise Security + Redwood Security (Lauren Bishop cc'd for coordination on evidence and KMS work)
- Procurement (Accountable for contract signing): Sunrise Procurement (cc'd)

I've updated the attached RACI draft to reflect the above. Aditya — can you confirm infra approach (Redwood-hosted isolated tenant vs. connecting to Sunrise Azure) and an ETA for provisioning if Sunrise opts for Redwood-hosted?

Procurement / Legal — happy to run the POCTerms through our legal team; we can prep a short addendum for the trial period to limit scope.

Attachments: updated Sunrise_RACI_Draft.pdf

Best,

Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Carter <jamie.carter@sunrisehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@sunrisehealth.com>, Security Team <security@sunrisehealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Action items: Trial infra provisioning & onboarding tasks (Sunrise Health POC)

Hi Aditya / Lauren —

Following the thread with Sunrise, please see the immediate action items so we can hit the Week 1 provisioning target if SOW is signed next week:

Aditya (Responsible) — trial infra + onboarding
- Decision point: Redwood-hosted isolated tenant vs. Sunrise Azure subscription. If customer chooses Redwood-hosted, provision single-tenant instance with KMS integration.
- Tasks: provision trial tenant, onboard model (gpt-neoX-20b equivalent), add KV/prefix cache, pre-warm runtime, create test user + API key for Sunrise.
- ETA: please provide a firm ETA (in business days) and list of required inputs from Sunrise (e.g., Azure tenant ID, KMS ARN, sample anonymized dataset).

Lauren (Consulted) — security & compliance coordination
- Collect SOC2 evidence links Redwood can provide; map evidence to Sunrise checklist.
- Coordinate with customer security for KMS and audit log configuration.

Marissa (Owner) — coordinate success criteria measurement plan & schedule the Week 2 evaluation run.

Also noting procurement asked for an estimated trial cost cap — Jamie, can you confirm the dollar threshold they need for internal approval? If they want a costless trial we can draft an addendum for a limited-time free trial but need approval from sales leadership.

Attachments: trial_onboarding_checklist.md

Thanks,

Marissa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jamie Carter <jamie.carter@sunrisehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@sunrisehealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Action items: Trial infra provisioning & onboarding tasks (Sunrise Health POC)

Hi all —

Confirming Redwood can provision a Redwood-hosted isolated tenant for the trial. High level plan and ETA: 
- Inputs needed from Sunrise (ASAP): preferred approach (Redwood-hosted or Sunrise Azure), if Azure then tenant ID + service principal for deployment; if Redwood-hosted then KMS key details for encryption at rest.
- Provisioning ETA (Redwood-hosted): 4 business days to stand up tenant, 1 business day to onboard model and pre-warm. Total ~5 business days after we have required inputs.
- Deliverables: trial tenant URL, API key (scoped), basic dashboard access, audit log links, and one test account for Alex.

Notes / risks:
- If they require the model to be quantized for cost we will propose a quantization profile; that will add 1 business day for validation.
- Cost model for trial: we can cap usage at an agreed threshold; please confirm.

I'll start the provisioning checklist as soon as we confirm approach and get the inputs.

Thanks,

Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
